universalAnswers.whatHappened: Anthropic announced one Claude experience for chat and Cowork.
universalAnswers.plainLanguageIdentity: The same conversation can handle a short answer or a longer job.
universalAnswers.evidenceBasis: Complete official announcement and help article.
universalAnswers.evidenceLimits: Provider sources only; no independent quality or adoption evidence.
universalAnswers.readerRelevance: A novice no longer needs to decide which Claude mode fits before starting.
universalAnswers.affectedPeople: Claude users as the staged plan-by-plan rollout reaches their accounts.
universalAnswers.changesNow: Pro and Max rollout first; Team and Free follow; Enterprise receives notice.
universalAnswers.uncertainty: Accounts on the same plan may receive the experience at different times.
universalAnswers.readerAction: Check the permission setting and specify allowed inputs before a longer task.
universalAnswers.betterQuestion: What may Claude use, when must it ask, and how will I check the result?

model-tool-release.productRange: One Claude conversation is replacing the separate Chat and Cowork choices as each account migrates.
model-tool-release.newCapabilities: Cowork-style multi-step tasks and finished-file creation become available from an ordinary conversation.
model-tool-release.bestFitTasks: A low-risk task with clear inputs and a result the reader can inspect, such as a household maintenance checklist.
model-tool-release.notFor: The sources do not establish reliable task completion, universal access, safety, privacy or independent quality.
model-tool-release.nearestAlternatives: Until migration, people who still see separate Chat and Cowork choices can keep using them as before.
model-tool-release.availability: Gradual rollout begins with Pro and Max on web, desktop and mobile; same-plan accounts may differ.
model-tool-release.freePaidBoundary: Pro and Max are first; Team and Free are due to follow; Enterprise organizations receive advance notice.
model-tool-release.costBoundary: The sources name plan order but do not announce a new price for the merged experience.
model-tool-release.limitations: Provider announcement and help documentation only; no independent usage or outcome evidence.
model-tool-release.technicalExampleProportionality: The article uses one original appliance-manual task and explains only the permission and execution boundaries needed for it.
model-tool-release.vendorEvidenceBoundary: Anthropic is the source for its own product, rollout and permission behavior; the article makes no performance claim.

translation.newsVersionExact: Anthropic announced September 16 that it is merging Claude chat and Cowork into one Claude experience.
translation.actualMeaningExact: A person can ask a quick question or hand over a longer, multi-step task without choosing a mode first.
translation.mechanismExact: Anthropic says Manual asks before actions; Auto reduces check-ins.
translation.familiarExampleExact: Once the new experience reaches your account, attach three appliance manuals and ask Claude to make an editable seasonal-maintenance checklist.

learningConnections.concept: Set an authority line before delegating an agent task.
learningConnections.learningPayoff: Name what the agent may do, when it must ask and when it must stop.
